title: sync script: LLM session can git commit the merge itself; no HEAD pin — main advances ungated while caller reports manual-resolution
description: Reviewer kimi-k3 pass 2.1. Session runs with shell/git access mid-merge up to 900s (sync-beads-workers.sh:110); pre-commit hook only blocks .beads/rust/crates/oscore. If the session runs 'git commit' itself: staged_now empties → missing gate returns 1 → caller's 'git merge --abort' (:316) silently no-ops (no merge in flight) → branch reported as manual-resolution while main ALREADY advanced with an ungated merge commit, and rerere records it. Fix: snapshot 'git rev-parse HEAD' before :110; if HEAD moved after the session, reset --hard to it before any gate.
